record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: For rank-2 vector bundles E on W1, is every admissible value of h^1(W1, End(E)) realized by some vector bundle E?

evidence.quote: Question 22. Is every admissible value of h^1(W1, End(E)) realized by some vector bundle E?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $W_1$ denote the total space of the line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-1)$ over $\mathbb{P}^1$ (equivalently, the blow-up of $\mathbb{C}^2$ at the origin), and let $\ell \subset W_1$ be the zero section (the exceptional curve, with $\ell\cdot\ell=-1$). It is known that every holomorphic rank-$2$ vector bundle $E$ on $W_1$ has a splitting type on $\ell$, i.e.\ $E|_\ell \cong \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(j)\oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-j)$ for a unique integer $j\ge 0$, and one knows sharp upper and lower bounds for the cohomology dimension
$$h^1\bigl(W_1,\,\mathrm{End}(E)\bigr) := \dim_{\mathbb{C}} H^1\bigl(W_1,\mathrm{End}(E)\bigr)$$
in terms of $j$ (and of the further numerical invariants of $E$). Call an integer $n\ge 0$ admissible if it lies in this known range of possible values for $h^1(W_1,\mathrm{End}(E))$ over rank-$2$ bundles on $W_1$.

Question: Is every admissible value $n$ actually realized, i.e.\ is there a holomorphic rank-$2$ vector bundle $E$ on $W_1$ with $h^1(W_1,\mathrm{End}(E)) = n$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in a 2021 list of open questions on vector bundles and their moduli. A web search did not turn up a subsequent paper announcing a resolution; the question of realizing all admissible values of $h^1(W_1,\mathrm{End}(E))$ for rank-$2$ bundles on $W_1$ appears to remain open.
